projects.title: Students API
projects.details: Built a RESTful backend service in Go for managing student records with full CRUD operations. Implemented endpoints to create a student, fetch by ID, and list all students with request validation and JSON responses. Used SQLite for persistent storage via database/sql and go-sqlite3, with cleanenv for config management.

projects.title: GitHub Repo Inspector
projects.details: Developed a CLI tool using Cobra to inspect any GitHub user's repositories and stats directly in the terminal. Features: list all public repos, sort by stars, filter by programming language, and view detailed repository stats. Added CLI flags for filtering repositories by stars and language for a seamless developer experience.

projects.title: Project Management System
projects.details: Built a full RESTful backend API for collaborative project management with JWT-based auth, email verification, and password reset. Implemented role-based access control (Admin / Project Admin / Member) with secure cookie handling and CORS. Designed MongoDB/Mongoose models for projects, tasks, subtasks, notes, and file attachments with status tracking (Todo / In-Progress / Done).
